patch_description:
Redesigned the ansatz block to reduce parameter count while keeping strong expressivity and better regularization via symmetry/parameter sharing. The new block:
- Uses pairwise parameter sharing for all single-qubit Euler rotations (qubits (0,1), (2,3), (4,5), (6,7) share the same parameters).
- Employs a structured, dense entangling pattern: a full ring of CZ gates plus an additional set of “skip” CZ chords.
- Adds a small number of parameterized CRZ gates restricted to the same qubit pairs (again with shared parameters per pair).
This cuts circuit parameters from 24 per block to 16 per block (→ fewer total trainable parameters), which typically improves parameter efficiency and reduces train-test gap while preserving accuracy.
Only ANSATZ_SPEC inside EVOLVE-BLOCK is changed; all inputs/outputs and the fixed training/feature-map/re-uploading/measurement pipeline remain identical.
